Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000318": As of 2025-04-07, the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000222": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry hammered the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000061": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000428" [decision]: As of 2025-06-06, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000387" [decision]: As of 2025-05-14, Cinder adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000108": Team Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000360": As of 2025-05-07, Marcus has the Boreal pager, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000446": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000390": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000442": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena Fischer.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000438": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000394": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000412" [constraint]: As of 2025-05-29, anything Boreal-related should be paged to Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
